map.合约单位 = 手数 × 100000；报价货币点值 = 合约单位 × 点大小；U: Contract units = lots × 100000; quote-currency pip value = contract units × pip size; USD pip value = quote-currency pip value ÷ quote-to-USD; if account is CNY then CNY pip value = USD pip value × 7.25; total P/L = pip value × pips.
